apps.localizedDescription:
Download Steam Workshop mods on your iPhone with ModShelf. Sign in to Steam, paste a Workshop link or find mods using the built-in browser.

Downloads are sorted into folders by game. Manage your mods in the library, check for updates, verify files, and export mods as ZIP files. Downloads can even run in a queue.

versions.localizedDescription:
Mods install with their folders intact again, and update checks are much quicker.

### Changes

- Mods unpack into their published folders again, and any that Files hid in its bin are put back
- Checking for updates asks Steam once for the whole library, and validates the files in the same pass
- Reinstall all, in the library menu, queues every mod you have added

More Workshop downloads work now - several kinds of item that used to fail were fixed

### Changes

- Items whose details Steam sends as an archive are read correctly instead of arriving empty
- Downloads that fail retry across more depots and every branch Steam lists before giving up

Fixed some Workshop mods not downloading properly

### Changes

- Downloads that used to fail for older Workshop items now work
- Depot items are retried across every route before giving up
- Download history now has a copy error button for reporting a failure
